source: Native Codewhale PTY via qa_harness; website_current_terminal_capture sequence
command: Run the opt-in crates/tui/tests/cucumber/launch_card_pty.rs::website_current_terminal_capture test (cargo test -p codewhale-tui --features long-running-tests --test cucumber -- --ignored --exact launch_card_pty::website_current_terminal_capture) with QA_TUI_BIN set to the commit-stamped Codewhale binary and QA_LAUNCH_CAPTURE_DIR set; it records all six frames

frames.state: home after offline first run, with the onboarding starter prompt
typed unsent prompt; no provider request
actual Fleet workbar in an empty offline session, opened from the launch screen
actual Tasks workbar in an empty offline session, opened from the launch screen

schema: {rows, cols, cells: [row][col] -> {x, text, fg, bg, flags}}; fg/bg are null (terminal default), a 0-255 palette index, or [r,g,b]; flags are rio-vt style bits (see crates/tui/tests/support/qa_harness/frame.rs capture_cells)
